bio.text: Bert Mizusawa, a retired U.S. Army major general, won the Republican primary for U.S. Senate in Virginia on August 4, 2026, according to the Associated Press.

According to his campaign website as reported by 7News, he has served in the federal government, including as Deputy Under Secretary of the Army, and has run his own contracting firm and law practice.
In a 2026 interview he said he graduated first in his class at West Point and served 41 years in the military, including four combat tours.
In 2018 he sought the Republican nomination for the Senate seat held by Tim Kaine; the Associated Press reported that he attended Harvard Law School.
